description: React component for displaying and managing a list of channel members in Mattermost, including loading data, handling search, pagination, and rendering a user list.

classes.name: MemberListChannel
classes.description: React component class for displaying a list of channel members with search and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to load initial data when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to clean up when component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to handle updates, especially search term changes.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Sets loading state to false after data is loaded.
